purpose: Focused production regression evidence; not a calibration matrix or measured admission record

request.prompt: A cinematic frame of a woman in a red raincoat holding a red umbrella standing in the middle of a neon street on a rainy night

execution.mechanism: dense global-attention head followed by tiled convolutional tail

phaseCapture.method: reset_peak_memory at Loading(TextEncoder), Loading(Renderer), Decoding; report final peak after generate returns

limitations: Physical host has 128 GiB; 8 GiB is an admission budget emulation, not hardware runtime proof.
Whole-request and phase-reset runs differ; the estimator uses the larger per-phase observations and the existing uncertainty policy.
Derived geometry and other-tier values are estimates, not measured records.
Decode observation is retained whole as workspace; current destination decoder weights are additionally charged.
